title: Vibrant Quick British Spring Onions Fritters
description: A fresh and quick-fix British dish featuring spring onions, perfect for a Mediterranean-friendly meal. This dish is a great way to enjoy the flavors of spring onions in a crispy and delicious fritter.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, salt, and pepper to make a smooth batter.
Add the chopped spring onions to the batter and stir until they are fully incorporated.
Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the skillet and flatten slightly.
Cook the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the skillet and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional chopped spring onions if desired.
